Questions

Before you commission.

Is the free preview the final portrait?

No. The preview is an on-device paint effect on your own photo, so you can see your pet's colours in an oil style. Your final portrait is created separately with AI image tools, in the costume and scene of the role you choose, and checked by a person.

How do I pay?

Secure checkout with PayPal or a debit or credit card. You don't need a PayPal account to pay by card.

When do I send my pet's photo?

Right after payment, your receipt has a link to upload the photo securely. Delivery times start once we have your photo. The photo you used for the free preview never leaves your device.

Will it really look like my pet?

We aim to match the coat, markings and face from your photo, and we repaint it free for 14 days if we miss. Still not right? Full refund.

Can I order for Christmas?

Yes. Nothing ships. Order and send your photo by December 23 (December 22 for the Classic package) and your portrait arrives before Christmas morning.

Is it hand-painted?

No. Portraits are digital artworks made with AI image tools in a classic oil-painting style, then checked and finished by a person. You receive high-resolution files to print or share.
